title: 第24章 买人气第25章 神道
slug: 我的灵根等级怎么是负的
content_zh:
这五个人之中，有两个人正在宗外执行任务，还没有回来，所以此刻这里只有三个人。
祝融等人不仅对这五人进行了仔细的调查，而且还观察了很长一段时间。他们对他们的评价非常高。
一间小房间里，沉翔看着三个年轻男子，其中两个体格魁梧，而且长相也差不多。显然，他们是兄弟。至于另外一个，看上去就像是一位书生，虽然穿着很简单，但是却很整洁，脸上挂着和蔼可亲的笑容。
两兄弟分别叫雷雄林和雷忠。
而雷雄林是老大，为人刚毅豪爽。然而，他说话的时候，常常显得有些粗鲁和沙哑。另一方面，他的弟弟雷忠却是一个淳朴老实的人。他平时的话很少，甚至连说话的时候，也确实不擅长说话。不过，两人都非常努力，否则也不会这么年轻就成为凡武境十级武者。
那个儒雅的男子名叫连明东。他是一个很精明的人，在天门城做过很多好事。不过，凡是想到画这种精明的人，心里都会生出一些怀疑，或许这个人有什么阴谋或阴谋。但是，沉翔却不怕这种事。
雷雄林、雷忠和丽娜明东都知道今天为什么会被邀请到这里来。他们知道有人想拉拢他们，这种事情他们也经历过好几次了。但最终因为没有背景而没有被选中。
宗门内，在拉拢人之前，一般都会考虑其背景。如果出身不错，比如小家族的小辈，或者大商人的儿女，就更容易被拉拢。
不过，对于沉翔来说，这是不可行的，因为那些人很可能不会忠于他，甚至为了他头上的赏金，他们很容易就会背叛他。
沉翔的名字在太武宗内响彻如雷。有人讨厌他，有人喜欢他，有人钦佩他，但大多数人只是嫉妒他。
如今雷雄林等人能够见到太武宗这样的‘大师般的人物’，心中都有些激动和惊讶。
“我就不废话了，虽然是第一次见面，但我想你们应该很熟悉，我已经调查过你们了，希望你们不要介意。”
沉翔微微一笑，“因为我想要多几个值得信赖的男人。”
连明东微微一愣，看了一眼雷雄林和雷忠，都是同一类人。三人都是很好的朋友，对此感到有些惊讶。
“你愿意加入我们吗？就这么简单，如果你愿意就加入我们就好了，如果不愿意，那就算了，至于了解对方什么，那以后再说了。”
云小刀说道。
云小刀、祝融等人，都是真武境的年轻武者。事实上，他们在太武宗内，是非常有名的。更何况，他们都是大家族的小辈。
雷雄林和雷重对视一眼，被这么有影响力的团体拉拢，他们当然高兴。然而，此时此刻，他们的眼中却充满了无奈。
连明东说道：“陈师兄好意邀请我们加入，我们非常感激，不过……上次任务的时候，我们一行人和一些人发生了冲突，还失去了两个同伴。
祝融笑道：“你是担心把我们拖入你们的矛盾之中吗？”

连明东点头，“是的，我知道师兄们都是年轻有为，但是……”
这时雷雄林怒吼道：“别说了！走吧，我们自己的事情自己处理！”
雷忠对着沉翔等人露出了一个很简单的笑容，说道：“如果我们加入你们的队伍，只会给你们带来麻烦，对不起。”
徐伟龙冷冷道：“谁针对你，还杀了你的两个同伴！虽然我们和你没有关系，但是我们的调查让我们佩服你，所以才想请你们来组个大团！
沉翔叹了口气，道：“如果我没猜错的话，应该是其他太武门弟子！唉，你跟他们拼命，却变成这样，简直是在浪费自己的生命……我有机会让你与魔道武者生死一战，这种生死战才是你最向往的！”
雷雄林和雷重浑身一颤，雷雄林立即问道：“什么机会？”
沉翔淡淡一笑，根据情报来看，雷雄林和雷忠的村子曾被魔道武者蹂躏过，所以他们对魔道武者的仇恨已经深入骨髓。
“既然召唤了你，我们就信任你了，如果你让我们失望了，那只是因为我们的眼睛无法辨别人！太武宗必须立即派出十名弟子，前往一个地方。”与魔道宗弟子一战，我替你们三人预留了三个名额，不过，你们必须是真武境！”
沉翔的话，让雷雄林等人倒吸一口凉气。他们和大多数人不一样，一般人一听到他们要和魔道武者战斗，都会担心起来。尤其是那些一副高傲、高雅的样子，都担心失去自己可怜的小命。他们很乐意与魔道宗妥协，与魔道宗分享辰武大陆丰富的资源。
但各大正派掌教却都明白魔道武者是怎样的人。如果任由它们生长，那么平民百姓和正义武者首当其冲，就没有好日子了。为了镇压魔道宗，需要一场恶战。
沉翔拿出六颗筑基丹，说道：“我可以送给你们每人两颗筑基丹。你们能否踏入真武境，就看你们的天赋、运气和气运了。”
“踏入真武境之后，要不要与我们联手，就看你的了。不过，你绝对不能像太武宗那些胆小鬼一样，不敢与魔人战斗。”小路！”
沉翔将六颗筑基丹放到了桌子上。
连明东、雷雄林、雷忠都愣住了。他们继续惊讶的看着那六颗筑基丹，全都说不出话来。别说他们了，就连云小刀等人也不由惊讶。沉翔刚刚给了他们每人两枚筑基丹，但是，他又拿出了六枚！
“这些筑基丹我可不是白给的，以后你得还给我们！我每丹要二十万晶石，如果你觉得以后可以还债的话，就收下吧。”
！”
沉翔笑道。
五十万晶石，既不是一笔无法支付的金额，也不是一笔小数目。不过，如果能够进入真武境，赚到这个数额也不是什么难事，只不过，还需要相当长的时间。
连明东等人都练了两枚筑基丹。他们感激地看着沉翔，心中发誓，要跟随沉翔至死不渝。他给了他们一个强大的机会，一个复仇的机会！不然的话，以他们的出身，天知道哪年哪月哪十年能够踏入真武境。又或许，他们这辈子就只能停留在凡武境十级了！
“等你进入真武境之后，立刻去找吴长老，让他为你好好安排一下。到时候告诉他，是沉翔派你来找他的。还有一点，现在只吃一丹，如果你用一个可以突破，另一个就可以留着，等你达到第二层的时候。”

沉翔认真的指导着他们。
雷雄林等人没有说话，只是对着沉翔握紧了拳头，跟着云小刀等人出去了。这样的恩情，不是简单的一句谢谢就能报答的，他们会用自己的行动来感谢沉翔所做的一切。
现在，只需要再增加一名候选人。沉翔只能回丹长老的王院去找丹长老。毕竟吴芊芊是最终的最佳人选，他只是担心丹长老将吴芊芊藏起来直至去世。
content_en:
Among these five people, two are on a mission outside the sect and have not returned yet, so there are only three people here at the moment.
Zhu Rong and others not only conducted a careful investigation of these five people, but also observed them for a long time. They rate them very highly.
In a small room, Chen Xiang looked at three young men, two of whom were tall and similar in appearance. Obviously, they are brothers. As for the other one, he looked like a scholar. Although he was dressed simply, he was very neat and had an amiable smile on his face.
The two brothers were named Lei Xionglin and Lei Zhong.
Lei Xionglin is the boss, and he is resolute and forthright. However, when he speaks, he often sounds a bit rude and hoarse. On the other hand, his younger brother Lei Zhong is a simple and honest man. He usually talks very little, and even when he talks, he is really not good at talking. However, both of them worked very hard, otherwise they would not have become level ten warriors in the Mortal Martial Realm at such a young age.
The elegant man's name is Lian Mingdong. He is a very shrewd man and has done many good things in Tianmen City. However, anyone who thinks about painting such a shrewd person will have some doubts in his heart, maybe this person has some conspiracy or conspiracy. However, Chen Xiang is not afraid of this kind of thing.
Lei Xionglin, Lei Zhong and Lina Mingdong all know why they were invited here today. They knew someone was trying to win over them, and they had experienced this several times. But in the end he was not selected because he had no background.
Within the sect, before wooing someone, their background is usually considered. If you are from a good background, such as a junior from a small family or a son or daughter of a big businessman, you will be more likely to be won over.
However, for Chen Xiang, this is not feasible, because those people will probably not be loyal to him, and they will even betray him easily for the bounty on his head.
Chen Xiang's name resounded like thunder in Taiwu Sect. Some hate him, some love him, some admire him, but most are just jealous of him.
Now that Lei Xionglin and others could see a 'master-like figure' like Tai Wuzong, they were a little excited and surprised.
"I won't talk nonsense. Although this is our first meeting, I think you should be familiar with me. I have already investigated you. I hope you don't mind."
Chen Xiang smiled slightly, "Because I want a few more trustworthy men."
Lian Mingdong was slightly startled and glanced at Lei Xionglin and Lei Zhong. They were both the same type of people. The three of them were all good friends and were a little surprised by this.
"Are you willing to join us? It's that simple. If you are willing, just join us. If you are not willing, forget it. As for understanding each other, we will talk about it later."
Yun Xiaodao said.
Yun Xiaodao, Zhu Rong and others are all young warriors in the True Martial Realm. In fact, they are very famous within Taiwu Sect. What's more, they are all juniors of a big family.
Lei Xionglin and Lei Zhong looked at each other. Of course they were happy to be attracted by such an influential group. However, at this moment, their eyes were full of helplessness.
Lian Mingdong said: "Senior Brother Chen kindly invited us to join, and we are very grateful. However... during the last mission, our group had a conflict with some people and lost two companions.
Zhu Rong smiled and said: "Are you worried about dragging us into your conflicts? "
Lian Mingdong nodded, "Yes, I know that the senior brothers are all young and promising, but..."
At this time Lei Xionglin roared: "Stop talking! Let's go, let's handle our own affairs! "
Lei Zhong showed a simple smile to Chen Xiang and others, and said: "If we join your team, we will only bring you trouble, I'm sorry. "
Xu Weilong said coldly: "Who targeted you and killed two of your companions! Although we have no relationship with you, our investigation has made us admire you,That’s why I wanted to invite you to form a big group!
Chen Xiang sighed and said: "If I guessed correctly, it should be other Taiwu Sect disciples! Alas, you fought hard with them, but ended up like this. You are simply wasting your life... I will have the opportunity to let you have a life-and-death battle with a demonic warrior. This kind of life-and-death battle is what you yearn for most!"
Lei Xionglin and Lei Zhong trembled, and Lei Xionglin immediately asked: "What opportunity?"
Chen Xiang smiled faintly. According to the intelligence, Lei Xionglin and Lei Zhong's villages had been ravaged by demonic warriors, so their hatred for the demonic warriors had been deeply rooted in their bones.
"Since we have summoned you, we trust you. If you disappoint us, it is only because our eyes cannot distinguish people! The Taiwu Sect must immediately send ten disciples to a place." In the battle with the Demon Dao Sect disciples, I have reserved three places for the three of you, but you must be at the True Martial Realm! "
Chen Xiang's words made Lei Xionglin and others take a breath of cold air. They are different from most people. Most people will become worried when they hear that they are going to fight a demonic warrior. Especially those who look arrogant and elegant, who are worried about losing their poor little lives. They are happy to compromise with the Demonic Sect and share the rich resources of Chenwu Continent with the Demonic Sect.
But all the major sect leaders understand what kind of person a demonic warrior is. If they are allowed to grow, ordinary people and righteous warriors will bear the brunt and will not have a good life. In order to suppress the Demon Dao Sect, a fierce battle is needed.
Chen Xiang took out six Foundation Establishment Pills and said, "I can give each of you two Foundation Establishment Pills. Whether you can step into the True Martial Realm depends on your talent, luck and luck. "
“After entering the True Martial Realm, it’s up to you whether you want to join forces with us or not. However, you must not be like those cowards of Taiwuzong who dare not fight the demon. "Trail!"
Chen Xiang placed six Foundation Establishment Pills on the table.
Even Mingdong, Lei Xionglin, and Lei Zhong were stunned. They continued to look at the six Foundation Establishment Pills in surprise, all of them speechless. Not to mention them, even Yun Xiaodao and others couldn't help but be surprised. Chen Xiang just gave each of them two Foundation Establishment Pills, but he took out six more!
"I didn't give these foundation-building pills for free. You have to pay them back to us in the future! I want two hundred thousand crystal stones for each pill. If you think you can repay the debt in the future, just accept it."
! "
Chen Xiang smiled.
Five hundred thousand crystal stones is neither an unpayable amount nor a small amount. However, if you can enter the True Martial Realm, it is not difficult to earn this amount, but it will still take a long time.
Even Mingdong and others have practiced two foundation-building pills. They looked at Chen Xiang gratefully and swore in their hearts that they would follow Chen Xiang until death. He gave them a powerful opportunity, a chance for revenge! Otherwise, based on their background, God knows in which year, month and decade they will be able to enter the true martial arts realm. Or maybe, they can only stay at the tenth level of the Mortal Martial Realm for the rest of their lives!
"After you enter the True Martial Realm, go to Elder Wu immediately and ask him to make good arrangements for you. Tell him when the time comes that Chen Xiang sent you to find him. Another point is, only take one pill now. If you can break through with one, you can keep the other until you reach the second level. "
Chen Xiang guided them carefully.
Lei Xionglin and others did not speak, but clenched their fists at Chen Xiang and followed Yun Xiaodao and others out. This kind of kindness cannot be repaid with a simple thank you. They will use their actions to thank Chen Xiang for everything he has done.
Now, it's just a matter of adding one more candidate. Chen Xiang could only go back to Elder Dan's royal courtyard to find Elder Dan. After all, Wu Qianqian was the best candidate in the end. He was just worried that Elder Dan would hide Wu Qianqian until his death.
